notes: Three final views, three spec candidates for v1 and v2, two for v3. Every candidate spec is preserved in this directory and every --check run is recorded in attempts-log.jsonl (labels match the 'record_label' fields below). The family hint (identity-probe-maps) oriented the view split by fact cluster; the source's own structure set each view's shape.

attempts.note: Merged ports + /29 pool into one tb view (6 nodes, 5 edges) to keep the case inside two views. --check read clean (0 crossings, 5/5 labels) but the pinned 77x47 dump showed the '.60-.62 free' edge label clipped to 'free · unpr' at the right canvas edge: the pool fan plus a 25-cell NIC box plus the s1 label exceeds the target width. Rejected on the capture, not on --check.

Ports-only chain (dark -> s1 -> nic -> gw) at tb. Clean at 58x28, but the ledger still had two uncovered rows: the full public address 103.19.91.58 (only the '.58/29' suffix appeared) and the source's MAC-OUI caveat ('MAC OUI does not prove a ToR role'). Rejected for coverage, not geometry.
CHOSEN. Full address on the host node, MAC-OUI basis with its 'role unproven' caveat on the gateway node. 0 crossings, 3/3 labels placed, 0 ambiguous owners.

Pool star at lr with label_slot on the spare edge (15-cell label). --check clean, but the 77x47 dump put 'free · unprobed' three rows BELOW the .60-.62 box, detached from its own dashed route (dashed run on one row, text on another). Rejected on the capture.

Same star, label_slot removed: label search now lands 'free · unprobed' directly above its dashed run. Clean geometry, but the access edge read only 'routed /29 · no NAT/v6' while the source states no NAT, no proxy AND no v6. Rejected for coverage.
CHOSEN. Adds 'proxy' to the public-access label. 0 crossings, 3/3 labels placed, 0 ambiguous owners, extent 75 of 77 columns (2 columns of margin).

Upstream chain with the long label '1.8 ms · unseen bridge/tunnel/silent'. --check clean, but the label line reached column 76 of 77 in the pinned dump: zero margin, and the role rows (routed L3 leaf) were still undrawn while the gateway label spent its width on the vendor qualifier. Rejected.

CHOSEN. Shorter fabric label ('bridge|tunnel|silent', the source's own three options) and the gateway label now carries the role the source names (L3 leaf) plus site/AS/city; MAX-OUI basis stays in v1/v2. Longest canvas line 69 of 77. 0 crossings, 3/3 labels placed.

abandoned_shapes_note: No separate shape experiments were run: every probe on this case was a per-view spec candidate and is listed above with its record label. The per-view three-candidate budget was reached exactly.
